name: Blender
title: Blender: free Cinema 4D alternative
caption:
Cinema 4D charges $839/year. Blender does 3D art and animation for free 🎨

✅ Sculpt models with 20 brush types
✅ Render realistic images with Cycles, on your CPU or graphics card
✅ UV unwrap and texture right inside the app
✅ No subscription, no watermark, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ Rendering is much faster with a supported graphics card (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel or Apple); on a CPU alone it works but is slower. Cinema 4D's $839/year is the annual-billed plan; it's $109/month if you pay monthly

Comment "RENDER" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

beats.say: Cinema 4D: eight hundred and thirty nine dollars a year for 3D art. Blender: zero.
Cinema 4D bills you every year. Blender costs nothing, forever.
You sculpt a model like clay, with twenty different brushes.
Unwrap it, paint right on the model, then render it with your graphics card.
It's Cinema 4D, minus the yearly bill.
